roster.savedOk: Saved. Staff see it once it is published.

roster.noUnitsTitle: No wards or departments to roster
roster.noUnitsHint: Your role’s scope does not include any ward or department.
roster.changedSince: — changed since; staff still see the published version until you publish again.
roster.paintHint: Pick a shift above, then tap the days. Tap a day again to clear it.
roster.note: Staff see only the published roster, and attendance follows the published roster — save as often as you like, then publish when it is ready. A night shift belongs to the day it starts and ends the next morning. Leave shows as a badge on the day (dashed while it is still waiting for approval); a shift someone has in another unit is shown in small print under the day.

muster.footnote: Payable days = present + ½ half days + paid leave + days off and holidays; LOP is the rest. Hours under each day are net of breaks.

policies.heading: Policies
policies.intro: Different rules for some staff. The most specific one wins: named staff, then department, then staff category (then the higher priority). A rule a policy leaves empty is the hospital default.
policies.emptyHint: Everyone follows the hospital default. Add a policy for a department on long shifts, doctors who may punch anywhere, or one person on fixed hours.
policies.saved: Policy saved. Days are worked out again with it as they are read.
policies.name: Name
policies.descriptionPlaceholder: Why these staff have different rules
policies.appliesToHint: Pick any mix. A person named here is held to this policy over any department or category policy.
policies.rulesHint: Switch on only what differs; the rest stays the hospital default and follows it when that changes.
policies.fixedMinutesHint: Fixed minutes replace the % of the shift; the full-day minutes never ask for more than the shift itself.
policies.whichApplyHint: Pick someone to see the policy in force for them and why.

policies.candidateHigherPriority: {{name}} · {{level}} · priority {{priority}} — not used (a higher priority wins)

sites.label: Sites & geofence
sites.hint: The places staff may mark themselves in and out. A self punch outside every site of their branch is flagged — or refused — as the Rules say.

rules.label: Rules & policies
rules.hint: The hospital default — how worked time is counted, the grace for late and early, what makes a half or full day, what happens when someone punches off-site — and policies with different rules for some departments, staff categories or people.

kiosks.label: Kiosks
kiosks.hint: Shared tablets at the gate or a nursing station where staff punch with their employee code and personal PIN instead of their own phone.

import.label: Import / export
import.hint: Bring in punches from a biometric machine’s export, or download the register.

setup.nothingHint: Your role can’t change attendance setup.

offsiteNote.OFF: Off-site punching is not checked by the hospital default (Rules & policies — a policy can differ for some staff). Only self punches from a phone or browser are checked; kiosk punches are recorded at the kiosk’s site, and biometric, imported and HR-entered punches are not checked.
offsiteNote.WARN: Off-site punching is allowed, but flagged by the hospital default (Rules & policies — a policy can differ for some staff). Only self punches from a phone or browser are checked; kiosk punches are recorded at the kiosk’s site, and biometric, imported and HR-entered punches are not checked.
offsiteNote.REQUIRED: Off-site punching is blocked by the hospital default (Rules & policies — a policy can differ for some staff). Only self punches from a phone or browser are checked; kiosk punches are recorded at the kiosk’s site, and biometric, imported and HR-entered punches are not checked.

setup.devicesHint: Devices that can push punches on their own connect through Integrations › Devices.
setup.exportRegisterHint: Each person’s days as status codes with the totals (payable, LOP, late, nights, net hours, missed punches, outside geofence). Up to 62 days.
